blocks.text: While Rochelle Pangilinan admitted that there have been misunderstandings within the SexBomb Girls, she stressed that they respect each other’s decisions on whether or not to take part in the group’s projects. Pangilinan spoke about this during an interview on “Fast Talk with Boy Abunda” on Wednesday, Sept. 16, which was also attended by some of her fellow group members. The topic was brought up after show host Abunda asked about the absence of Sunshine Garcia and Jopay Paguia from the music video of the group’s latest song “Mama Mama.” He further cited speculations of a rift between Pangilinan and Paguia.
